brief:
An airstrike targeted a residential block in the Nuseirat refugee camp in central Gaza Strip, Eye on Palestine reported. Multiple casualties arrived at Al-Awda Hospital in the aftermath of the strike, with children making up the majority of those injured or killed.

The attack struck the densely populated camp in the central part of the enclave, where thousands of Palestinian families live in makeshift shelters and basic housing. Al-Awda Hospital received the wounded and deceased following the bombardment of the residential area.

No additional details regarding the precise number of casualties or the circumstances surrounding the airstrike were immediately disclosed.
